Hey team! Starting my turn on building some supporting pieces for Aura. I'll start with task T-020: High-resolution card & Wrapped image renderer via share sheet.

### What I'm about to build:
I'll create `ImageExporter.swift` in the Services/Export folder. This will handle rendering high-resolution images (1080x1920) for individual Aura cards and the monthly Wrapped export. It will use the native iOS share sheet for exporting these images.

### Building the code:

#### Step 1: Create ImageExporter.swift

```swift
// Services/Export/ImageExporter.swift

import UIKit
import SwiftUI

protocol ImageExporter {
    func exportCard(entry: DayEntry, watermarked: Bool) throws -> URL
    func exportWrapped(month: MonthlyWrapped, entries: [DayEntry]) throws -> URL
}

struct DefaultImageExporter: ImageExporter {
    
    private let renderer: AuraRenderer
    
    init(renderer: AuraRenderer) {
        self.renderer = renderer
    }
    
    // MARK: - Export Individual Card
    
    func exportCard(entry: DayEntry, watermarked: Bool) throws -> URL {
        let cgImage = try await renderer.renderFullExport(recipe: entry.recipe, watermarked: watermarked)
        
        return saveImageToDisk(cgImage: cgImage, filename: "aura_card_\(entry.dateKey).png")
    }
    
    // MARK: - Export Wrapped Poster
    
    func exportWrapped(month: MonthlyWrapped, entries: [DayEntry]) throws -> URL {
        let cgImage = try await renderer.renderWrappedPoster(month: month, entries: entries)
        
        return saveImageToDisk(cgImage: cgImage, filename: "aura_wrapped_\(month.monthKey).png")
    }
    
    // MARK: - Helper Methods
    
    private func saveImageToDisk(cgImage: CGImage, filename: String) throws -> URL {
        guard let image = UIImage(cgImage: cgImage) else {
            throw NSError(domain: "AuraError", code: 1001, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: "Failed to create UIImage from CGImage"])
        }
        
        let documentsDirectory = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        let fileURL = documentsDirectory.appendingPathComponent(filename)
        
        guard let data = image.pngData() else {
            throw NSError(domain: "AuraError", code: 1002, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: "Failed to convert UIImage to PNG data"])
        }
        
        try data.write(to: fileURL)
        return fileURL
    }
}
```
